# `em select linker set`

- **Usage:** `em select linker set [-t --target <TARGET>] <PROFILE>`

Set the active linker profile

## Arguments
- **`<PROFILE>`** — Linker profile to activate (e.g., `riscv64-unknown-linux-gnu-lld-18` or `1` for list number)

## Flags
- **`-t --target <TARGET>`** — Target tuple (CTARGET) for cross-linker selection
- **`-h --help`** — Print help

## Output Formats

- **`json`** — Machine-parsable JSON (`--json` with `-p` or `--info`)

  **Framing:** `json`
